home.description: A five-minute view of Europe jet fuel stress signals, SAF tipping-point events, EU ETS cost impact, and AI-assisted research workflows.

faq.meta_description: JetScope FAQ for launch readiness, source review, research workbench boundaries, scenario writes, and protected operations.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question: Is this state a product failure, or is the capability intentionally not enabled?

scope.title: What can JetScope review today?
scope.why: The stated review scope shows which decisions the product can support without overstating its reach.
scope.body: JetScope combines jet-fuel prices, SAF breakeven pressure, EU reserve stress, source quality, saved scenario assumptions, and research signals into one review workflow.

readiness.title: Why can launch readiness be not ready?
readiness.why: Separating configuration gaps from product failures makes the correct recovery action clear.
readiness.body: Launch readiness reports the actual environment. Missing management configuration, disabled AI research, database issues, or degraded source coverage are disclosed as blockers or review items instead of being hidden.

sources.title: How should I read degraded or fallback sources?
sources.why: A degraded source changes where its figures are safe to use and therefore needs review before citation.
sources.body: Source review separates live, proxy, fallback, unavailable, and error states. A degraded source can still be useful, but it should be reviewed before procurement or reporting use.

research.title: Why might the research workbench be disabled?
research.why: Disabled research is not evidence that the market produced no new signal.
research.body: The Research workbench does not pretend that AI analysis is live when the pipeline is disabled or credentials are incomplete. It shows the boundary and the next review actions.

scenarios.title: Can I save scenarios or refresh market data here?
scenarios.why: Protected writes need explicit authorization before a read-only state can be treated as a malfunction.
scenarios.body: Scenario writes and refresh operations are protected. Without the configured management token, localized FAQ pages and review surfaces stay read-only and link back to the primary workspaces.

limitations: These answers describe the current deployment design intent and do not change with live data; use the Admin page for the environment’s actual readiness.
The FAQ does not replace the current states and limitations on the Sources, Research, or Scenarios pages.

reports.meta_description: English JetScope report readiness workbench for source status, saved scenarios, risk signals, and launch posture.
reports.title: Report Workbench
reports.question: Is this report solid enough to be published as decision evidence right now?
reports.readiness_hint_fallback: The report surface can render, but the local API fallback is active: {error}.
reports.readiness_hint_degraded: Source status is {status}; review source evidence before launch or publication.
reports.readiness_hint_ok: Report entry points can be reviewed from the current read model.
reports.risk_hint_none: The market history window has not produced a ranked alert yet.
reports.catalog_why: Each report entry point, and whether it is wired to live data or to a static narrative.
reports.actions_why: The next report step is evidence review, not guesswork - every entry point leads to something verifiable.

catalog.title: Tipping-point report
catalog.description: Primary long-form report tying reserve pressure, fuel economics, airline decision probability, and research signals together.

actions.label: Review source evidence
actions.description: Check fallback, proxy, degraded, and volatility rows before treating report output as decision evidence.

actions.label: Open decision cockpit
actions.description: Return to the current market snapshot, source posture, scenarios, and top risk signal.

actions.label: Open research workbench
actions.description: Confirm whether research signals are enabled, empty, degraded, or ready for explanatory use.

reports.footer_market_ok: Market snapshot API (source status, confidence, fallback rate, freshness)
reports.footer_market_fallback: Market snapshot API unreachable; built-in fallback values are in use ({error})
reports.footer_risk: The risk signal is derived from movement across the market history window, not supplied upstream
limitations: "Publish candidate" means the data path is reviewable, not that a human has reviewed the conclusion.
The risk signal depends on history-window sample size. No alert on thin samples does not mean no risk.
Saved scenarios are local assumptions for review and discussion; they do not replace procurement approval.
